title: Landing composition
question: The Night Switchboard stays. Pick how the ChatApp landing is structured. Primary action is Try it now → /login. Hero proof is an authored (not live-API) interactive thread. The page lives at / for everyone; logged-in visitors get Open app in the nav.

options.label: Stacked Switchboard
options.lineage: Classic marketing stack, Night Switchboard identity
options.thesis: Centered offer, then the authored thread as proof, then the real chat jobs, then a close.
options.viewport: Sticky dark nav; large centered headline and Try it now; interactive ChatApp thread staged under the copy; How it works, capabilities, footer.
options.risk: This is the category-default landing shape; it can feel like a template if the thread is a static picture.

raised.raise: How it works is a visible trail (Log in → Find people → Chat), not three equal icon cards.
Unread pills and timestamps in the demo light and swap instantly, like live instruments.

options.label: Three-step Morph
options.lineage: The product’s own 3-step ritual as the first viewport
options.thesis: The hero is Log in → Find people → Chat, and the fake UI morphs through those states.
options.viewport: Nav; hero occupies the fold as three sequenced stages of the real UI (login sheet, search list, typing thread) with Try it now always visible; quieter capability list and footer below.
options.risk: A slideshow of screens can stall persuasion if the CTA is not locked while the UI morphs.

options.label: Full-bleed Switchboard
options.thesis: The first viewport is the ChatApp shell itself; copy and Try it now sit on a plate over the live-looking thread.
options.viewport: Nav over a near-full-bleed authored chat (sidebar + indigo/grey bubbles typing). Offer and Try it now on a 16px night-glass plate. Features and footer after the fold.
options.risk: Looks like an app screenshot with a sticker if the thread does not actually type and the overlay hides the proof.

options.label: Instrument Mask
options.lineage: Seven-segment clocks / scoreboards fused onto the Night Switchboard
options.thesis: Realtime is shown as cells that ignite: the hero thread is a rigid instrument, not a brochure screenshot.
options.viewport: Nav as a status strip; hero is a masked grid where an authored conversation lights cell by cell; Try it now is a lit control; sections below stay plates.
options.case: Holds night-operator identification with the switchboard; loses some chat clarity if cells overpower bubbles.
options.risk: Can read as a clock novelty if Inter and bubbles disappear.

options.label: Trail Map
options.case: Map-inference is the wrong job for a first-time chat visitor.
options.kept: How it works as a single visible route.

options.label: Edition Rack
options.case: A rack of repeats hides the primary Try it now action.
options.kept: One conversation restaged, not a collage of unrelated shots.
